title: The conductivity problem with imperfect bonding interfaces and finite internal conductivities
summary: We study the field concentration phenomenon between two closely spaced inclusions with imperfect bonding interfaces of low conductivity type. The inclusions are assumed to have finite conductivities. The problem is governed by a system of elliptic equations coupled with Robin-type boundary conditions.
